maintainedBy: hand (plan item 7013); checked by scripts/contract-ci.ts (mise run contract:ci). The schedule with dates: mise run contract:ci -- --retirements [--json]
adapters: Every adapter in adapters.json below its domain's current version. Adapter v is deleted when the support floor passes the first Stable release that advertises the domain at v + 1 or higher (adapter 0: the first Stable release that advertises the domain).

get_client_state_capabilities.why: Kept registered for renderers before config v1 (pre-contract), which ask it; a renderer with config answers it from the version.

get_native_agent_sync_capabilities.why: Kept registered for renderers before native-sessions v1 (pre-contract), which ask it; a renderer with native-sessions answers it from the version.

get_agent_handoff_capabilities.why: Kept registered for renderers before native-sessions v1 (pre-contract), which ask it; a renderer with native-sessions answers it from the version.

changes_get_capabilities.why: Partly folded (plan item 7006): git v1 implies change-tracking-v1, but restore, strictCheckpoints and policyVersion are the backend's policy, which version 1 still asks.

design_capabilities.why: Reports the design service's readiness at run time (plan item 7004); version 1 answers only the support flags itself.

get_preview_capabilities.why: Reports preview surfaces and the access kill switch at run time (plan item 7004); every version reads it.

transcript_artifact_capabilities.why: Reports the artifact renderer and rollout flags at run time (plan item 7004); every version reads it.

web_annotations_capabilities.why: Reports annotation storage and rollout mode at run time (plan item 7004); version 1 answers only the contract-version check itself.
